content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance carrier and annuity provider, not an investment manager; it takes premiums rather than managing client capital for fees."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory services firm; it sells professional advice, not investment fund management."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; it places policies rather than managing investment portfolios."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Real asset and income fund manager selling funds and separate accounts to institutions for management fees, overlapping GCM's real assets and institutional business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Public mutual fund and ETF manager in equity and fixed income, sold largely via advisors and retail; not private markets alternatives."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Financial data and analytics software vendor selling subscriptions; it does not manage investment portfolios or funds."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mainly retail mutual and closed-end fund manager with some private funds; core business differs from institutional alternatives."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Operates over-the-counter trading marketplaces and issuer disclosure services; no investment management or fund business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and families, with financial planning; not institutional alternatives investing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Financial software and outsourced back-office operations provider; it runs operations rather than investing client capital."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Affiliated boutique manager mostly selling public funds through retail advisers; alternatives are a minor part of its business."}]}
